title: The specified scalar tensor representative data
statement: For a finite commutative ring R, a scheme T and an intrinsic tensor model a, construct ScalarTensorRepresentativeData from the fixed-scalar and intrinsic localization functors, the ordinary and derived coefficient equivalences, their actual exact factors, the published tensor representatives, the ordinary total tensor isomorphism, and finiteScalarTensorRealization. Its normalization field is the existing scalar representative equation. Every data field is an explicit existing construction; no witness is selected.

source.place: Tags 07A4 and 07A6; representative cancellation in the scalar tensor-pullback square

proof.text: Fill the representative-data record with the two specified localization functors, the termwise ordinary realization and specified derived realization, the existing mapDerivedCategoryFactors isomorphism, the two representative classes and their preservation theorem, the constructed tensor representatives and total comparison, and the specified scalar tensor isomorphism. The normalization is exactly finiteScalarTensorRealization_Y_representative. Use finiteScalarTensorSharedRepresentative_normalization for the representative change of coordinates, then substitute the component equation of the specified ordinary total realization.

def finiteScalarTensorRepresentativeData
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Finite R] (T : Scheme.{u})
    (a : ProEtaleTensorModel T (proEtaleConstantRing T R)) :
    ScalarTensorRepresentativeData
      (CochainComplex (Sheaf (ProEt.topology T)
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} R))) ℤ)
      (CochainComplex (proEtaleRingModules T (proEtaleConstantRing T R)) ℤ)
      (DerivedCategory (Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} R))))
      (DerivedCategory (proEtaleRingModules T (proEtaleConstantRing T R)))
